integrity_repairs.defect: A caller-provided observed count could be scored without proving that it was the count derived from the retained official final feed.
integrity_repairs.repair: The evaluator now accepts only a hash-bound official outcome record, revalidates hard game/team/side/player identity and count algebra, and derives Hits, HR, or Total Bases itself.
integrity_repairs.mutation_proof: Tampered and tampered-then-rehashed outcome records both fail.

integrity_repairs.defect: Prediction provenance hashes did not bind the exact probability value consumed by the evaluator.
integrity_repairs.repair: Every candidate, league-rate, player-rate, frozen, and market probability is bound to its hard identity, exact T-4 horizon, source identity, and consumed-value SHA-256.
integrity_repairs.mutation_proof: Changing a probability without its bound prediction record fails.

integrity_repairs.defect: The high-probability calibration tail was independently reselected for each comparator, so models could be compared on different players.
integrity_repairs.repair: The candidate top decile is selected once at each line and the identical cohort is used for every comparator.
integrity_repairs.mutation_proof: The report exposes the fixed cohort size and every comparator consumes the same indices.

integrity_repairs.defect: Binary proper-score materiality versus league and time-safe player-rate baselines was not required at every declared market line.
integrity_repairs.repair: Hits, HR, and Total Bases now require paired date-cluster Brier and log-loss materiality at every line against every required comparator.
integrity_repairs.mutation_proof: A candidate that loses to the player/league baselines at HR over 0.5 is ineligible even if another comparison looks favorable.

integrity_repairs.defect: A subset of successful dates could be evaluated without an exact disposition for every date in the locked 56-day population.
integrity_repairs.repair: All 56 calendar dates require explicit immutable dispositions; any failed or incomplete date remains a promotion blocker and cannot be replaced.
integrity_repairs.mutation_proof: A missing date fails validation and a terminal failed date produces an explicit promotion blocker.

integrity_repairs.defect: Outcome parsing and decision-horizon provenance could be invoked without proving the outcome-opening boundary and exact T-4 chronology.
integrity_repairs.repair: The opening gate runs before projection parsing, official dates are restricted to the locked window, horizons must equal official start minus four hours, and post-horizon inputs fail.
integrity_repairs.mutation_proof: Early opening, out-of-window date, non-T-4 horizon, post-horizon prediction, duplicate JSON key, and malformed final-feed mutations all fail.

market_gates.hits: separate full-count and over-0.5/1.5 adjudication required
market_gates.home_runs_over_0_5: separate full-count and over-0.5 adjudication required, including candidate-fixed high tail
market_gates.total_bases: separate full-count and over-0.5 through over-5.5 adjudication required

remaining_evidence_gaps: No new batter-only challenger has earned selection over the empirical-Bayes player-rate control.
Fresh outcomes remain sealed until the predeclared opening time.
The shared AWS collector captures the empirical-Bayes control but does not yet capture an exact T-4 frozen-production comparator or verified market-implied comparator for every market.
No market can be promoted without its own complete comparator, coverage, calibration, discrimination, and uncertainty evidence.
single_highest_value_next_action: Create and deploy a separate fail-closed T-4 comparator-capture lane for exact frozen-production probabilities and receipt-verified market probabilities, without changing or restarting either running collector; any missed dates remain permanently missing.
